judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Content Domain Specific Learning Outcomes at the same grain, same Class IX coordinate (rank 0), and share the Chapter 'Structure of atoms' within Content Domain 'Materials', so hierarchy alone is not decisive; the judgment rests on statement text.
